never: cast to any to silence a type error
add non-null assertions without proving the invariant
retry payment or webhook side effects without an idempotency key
fall back to a second data store silently
claim success from an HTTP status alone

families.prevention: Run split server/client typechecks with fresh build metadata; preserve strict null and structural types.
families.safeAction: Apply only position-verified, syntax-gated handlers for a known diagnostic; otherwise report the exact diagnostic.
families.verifyBy: The same split typecheck reports zero diagnostics and the affected regression test passes.

families.prevention: Run ESLint on the same source set used by deployment; keep generated/vendor trees explicitly configured.
families.safeAction: Run ESLint's own --fix, then stop for non-fixable rules; never rewrite code with a blanket regex.
families.verifyBy: A fresh ESLint run exits zero and the changed file passes syntax/type checks.

families.prevention: Run the authoritative parser before semantic or mechanical fixes.
families.safeAction: Stop downstream autofix, report the parser location, and restore the last syntax-safe snapshot.
families.verifyBy: The project parser/esbuild syntax gate passes for every touched file.

families.prevention: Validate nullable inputs at boundaries and preserve consumer-facing object shapes.
families.safeAction: Classify from the stack and input shape; restart only if the process is unhealthy, otherwise escalate unknown variants.
families.verifyBy: The original request or worker job completes and no repeat error occurs within the observation window.

families.prevention: Check the live application schema and use idempotent transactions/constraints.
families.safeAction: Retry only connection failures with bounded backoff; never manufacture columns, drop constraints, or retry a duplicate mutation.
families.verifyBy: A live schema query and the affected transaction/regression test both pass.

families.prevention: Use the single configured PDIM endpoint for both Redis/state and platform storage; validate command/result shapes.
families.safeAction: Probe the real endpoint, apply bounded circuit recovery, and escalate persistent command failures; never switch silently to an unrelated store.
families.verifyBy: PING plus the affected command succeeds against the configured endpoint, followed by a real application operation.

families.prevention: Use idempotent handlers and align lock/visibility timeouts with the real queue round-trip.
families.safeAction: Acknowledge only documented self-healing lock races; reset bounded executor state, never duplicate a side effect.
families.verifyBy: The job's own durable side effect exists exactly once and the queue returns to healthy processing.

families.prevention: Use bounded timeouts, circuit breakers, retry budgets, and health-aware dependency routing.
families.safeAction: Retry idempotent reads with bounded exponential backoff; open the circuit and report degraded for persistent failures.
families.verifyBy: The dependency health probe and the original idempotent operation succeed after recovery.

families.prevention: Verify credentials at the boundary, use double-submit CSRF, and keep authorization separate from authentication.
families.safeAction: Reject and audit; never refresh, weaken, or bypass credentials automatically.
families.verifyBy: Valid and invalid credential tests preserve the expected status and no secret appears in the response/log.

families.prevention: Verify signatures, persist event IDs, and make ledger mutations idempotent.
families.safeAction: Acknowledge valid non-applicable events; retry only transient provider failures; never repeat a charge or ledger booking blindly.
families.verifyBy: The event is recorded once and the customer/ledger state matches the provider event.

families.prevention: Atomically claim metadata, enforce owner checks, and make delete/restore idempotent.
families.safeAction: Retry only transient transport errors; preserve metadata on uncertain writes and report reconciliation required.
families.verifyBy: A real upload/read/delete/restore round trip verifies bytes, ownership, and database tracking.

families.prevention: Use unique keys, transactional claims, bounded locks, and deterministic ownership.
families.safeAction: Retry only a proven transient conflict with jitter; never repeat an external side effect without an idempotency key.
families.verifyBy: A concurrent regression test proves one durable winner and no lost/duplicated side effect.

families.prevention: Run memory-heavy checks serially, cap worker fan-out, and monitor RSS/heap separately.
families.safeAction: Reduce bounded concurrency or restart a known-leaking worker; never mark a killed check as passed.
families.verifyBy: The same command completes with exit zero under the documented resource budget.

families.prevention: Use one canonical build/start path and verify artifacts, ports, dependencies, and readiness.
families.safeAction: Stop promotion on missing artifacts or degraded readiness; do not fall back to stale build outputs.
families.verifyBy: A clean build starts through the canonical launcher and settled readiness is healthy.
